regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood leads with 27" over six days, with 15" on Friday. The NWS has a Winter Storm Warning from Friday through Saturday, with heavy snow Friday night and gusts to 53 mph. Sugar Bowl sees 25", Palisades 24".

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth expects 13" through Tuesday, with 8" on Friday. Friday night brings heavy snow, wind chill near 7, and gusts to 65 mph. A Winter Storm Warning runs Friday through Saturday. The NWS is calling for more, 14" to 26" from Friday through Monday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler totals 17" with 7" on each of Saturday and Sunday, but rain is mixed in through much of the period. Environment Canada expects periods of rain Saturday and rain Sunday. Cypress Mountain sees 4", mostly Sunday.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride expects 12", with 6" Saturday and 6" Tuesday, in snow showers. Crested Butte sees 5" and Aspen Highlands 3". Saturday brings snow showers before the next round Tuesday.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Stevens Pass sees 9" through Sunday, with rain and snow mixing Saturday through Monday. Crystal Mountain totals 7", and Mt. Baker 7". Expect rain at lower elevations, and snow levels may limit depth at the base.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek expects 13" with 8" on Tuesday, and the NWS has raised its forecast to 13" to 23" from Friday night through Tuesday night. Taos sees 4" and Tuesday's snow showers are likely. Saturday also brings a slight chance of thunderstorms.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbasin and Powder Mountain each see 7", and Snowbird 6". Expect rain mixing in at times, especially Tuesday. The NWS raised Powder Mountain to 4" to 12" from Friday night through Tuesday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Sun Valley sees 7", with 4" Tuesday, though rain mixes in and snow levels run low. Grand Targhee totals 4" with snow showers Saturday and Tuesday. Jackson Hole sees 2" on Tuesday.
